text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—So, what'd you call me out here for?
Did I mess something up?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No.
It's not that sort of matter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I'll be blunt with you.
Katsuragi Ace, do you have any interest in joining the student council?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Me!? Why—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...As a fellow Umamusume,
I hold great respect for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your running and the way you carry yourself hold great influence.
I recognize that to this day, countless people
have been positively inspired by you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Such influence—
the power of an "ace" to kindle courage in people's hearts—
is precisely what would flourish in the Student Council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"On top of that, you've achieved the tremendous feat
of capturing both the Spring and Autumn Senior Triple Crowns."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are an immense number of students who look up to you.
If you count those outside the academy, the number would be staggering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If only to help guide them—
would you please lend your strength
to the student council?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks.
It makes me happy to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sorry!!
I'll have to pass!! There's no way I can do that!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask why, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hmm... A lot of things happened, but... to put it simply, "guiding" just isn't really my style.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...In the past, and from here on out, I only plan to keep moving 'forward.'
Or maybe... that's all I'm really capable of."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"And so, whenever I 'move' 'forward',
all I ever think about is moving forward with myself
and the things I'm carrying."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It's like I can't even see anyone else around me. I dunno, all I know is I'm looking straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Being on the student council is the exact opposite.
I think only someone who's constantly thinking about others can pull it off. ...Like Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...You're overestimating me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, Rudolf said it herself, right?
'I want to make every Umamusume happy.'"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I guess... even there, you and I wouldn't see eye to eye on a lot of things.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'm rooting for everyone who fights in this world.
Even though... it's full of nothing but pain."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if fighting leads to happiness.
Even when you suffer and give it your all,
there are plenty of times it goes unrewarded.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“I believe the fact that you fought, and the spirit
of trying to fight, matters more than anything...
Uh, what I mean is... um...—”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Thank you, Ace. It came across loud and clear.
The difference in our stances, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides—
to be honest, I figured you'd turn me down anyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I-Is that so!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was told so with absolute certainty.
...By someone who knows you very well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
......I wonder if Rudolph
is saying something again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "If I catch a cold, Ace is gonna yell at me. Time to head ho~me."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Unfortunately, things didn't work out with the student council, but nonetheless, I personally find you very intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, for my future reference,
could you tell me about your journey up until now?
I'd love to hear it straight from your own mouth.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My past?
Would you really find that interesting?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Your journey to becoming the "ace" of the Umamusume world—
that brilliance is something that should undoubtedly be passed down to future generations for a long time to come.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll serve tea and sweets, too.
How does that sound?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Well, works for me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Um, where should I start—
